After a time he was restored as Attending Censor of the Left Terrace, which Wu Zetian specially praised.

Soon he was restored as Director of the Left Office and rose to Vice Minister of the Court of Judicial Review.

Soon he was raised as Director of the Left Office and repeatedly promoted to Vice Minister of the Court of Judicial Review.

身為大理 means he serves in the Court of Judicial Review, not that his title is Grand Justice.

In the second year of Chang'an he died at age sixty-two and was posthumously given Chief Minister of the Court of Judicial Review.
司刑卿 is Chief Minister of the Court of Judicial Review, not Vice Minister of Punishments.

不順其情 means if one did not comply with their wishes, not that they ignored the truth in general.

定國 and 釋之 are the given names Dingguo and Shizhi, not Ding Guo and Shi Zhi. 何以加此 asks how they could surpass this.

When he held judgment and decided, all met reversal of wrongful cases; how could Dingguo and Shizhi surpass this?
定國 and 釋之 are two-character given names, Dingguo and Shizhi.
We alone renew the multitude of policies, recall former traces; the man has already died, yet his virtue can be praised.
We now renew the government and recall his former path; the man has already died, yet his virtue can be praised.
朕惟新庶政 is 'I now renew the government', not 'We alone renew'.
Let him be posthumously made prefect of Yuezhou; send envoys to mourn at his home, grant a hundred gifts, and give office to one son."
Let him be posthumously made prefect of Yuezhou; send envoys to mourn at his home, bestow one hundred bolts of silk, and give office to one son."
